slides.text: What does the research actually say? Let's check 👉

slides.title: A 15-amino-acid peptide
slides.text: Described as a fragment of a gastric juice protein. Sold online as “for research only”, which means not as a medicine.
That is how many small human studies a 2025 review found. Under 30 people in total and no control groups. The rest is animal research.
In July 2026 an FDA advisory committee only backed it (8 to 6) as a compounding ingredient. That is not drug approval.
